name: CountRowsPerGroupNode
label: Count Rows Per Group
description: Adds a column with the number of rows in each group, optionally counting distinct values of a column.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to count rows for.

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns to group by. Leave empty to count the whole table.

fields.name: DistinctColumn
fields.label: Distinct Column
fields.description: Optional column to count distinct values of instead of counting all rows. Leave empty to count all rows.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the result column. Defaults to 'RowCount'.
